name: @pipeworx/mcp-crc

tools.name: crc32
tools.description: Compute the CRC-32 (IEEE) checksum of UTF-8 text — the algorithm used by zip/gzip/PNG. Returns the unsigned 32-bit value and its hex form. Keyless, offline. (Error-detection checksum, not cryptographic.)

tools.name: adler32
tools.description: Compute the Adler-32 checksum of UTF-8 text (as used by zlib). Returns the unsigned value and hex. Keyless, offline.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-crc forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the crc pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
